description: Pre-trade safety in one keyless call, chain auto-detected. Solana: quotes a real buy-then-sell round trip through Jupiter routing (sell route exists? round-trip loss %, price impact) plus Token-2022 traps (transfer fee, transfer hook, permanent delegate, non-transferable, default-frozen) and mint/freeze authority. Base: honeypot/sell-tax/blacklist/owner-control flags plus DEX liquidity. Pre-migration pump.fun / Raydium LaunchLab tokens are quoted on their bonding curve, so a missing Jupiter route is never called a honeypot. Adds top-holder concentration, liquidity lock, creator launch history, mutable metadata and price changes. Returns verdict SELLABLE / RISKY / UNKNOWN / UNSELLABLE with reasons. ($0.005 USDC per call via x402 at https://coinlight-app.vercel.app/p/token-sell-check)

payment.description: Optional x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to use a free trial call or get payment requirements.

sizeUsd.description: Trade size to simulate in USD (Solana), 1-10000. Default 50.

token.description: Solana mint (base58) or Base ERC-20 0x address.
